types.name: PET
types.note: Unmodified PET - runs hotter than PETG

types.name: PHA
types.note: Polyhydroxyalkanoate, usually sold as a PLA/PHA blend

types.name: PP
types.note: Polyolefins keep their OWN compat group so endless spool never swaps them with a chemically unrelated material. Poor bed adhesion.

types.name: PE
types.note: Polyethylene - negligible moisture uptake, no drying

types.name: CoPE
types.note: Semi-flexible but does NOT interchange with TPU, so it has its own compat group. Nozzle range taken from the only shipped product, uncertain.

types.name: EVA
types.note: Semi-flexible but does NOT interchange with TPU, so it has its own compat group. Conservative range, uncertain; low Vicat so no drying.

types.name: SBS
types.note: Semi-flexible but does NOT interchange with TPU, so it has its own compat group.

types.name: PLA-AERO
types.note: Foaming/lightweight grade: the wide nozzle range IS the control knob (hotter = more foaming). Density is the UNFOAMED value, so length-from-weight is approximate.

types.name: ASA-AERO
types.note: Foaming/lightweight grade: the wide nozzle range IS the control knob (hotter = more foaming). Density is the UNFOAMED value, so length-from-weight is approximate.
